statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-89156: PCRE2 before 10.48 can read out of bounds in pcre2_match() when the interpreter falls back from JIT for a match mode that was not JIT-compiled and the subject is invalid UTF supplied by an attacker. Upstream fixed it in PCRE2 10.48 (item 25 of the 10.48 ChangeLog, pull request https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/pull/926; https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/security/advisories/GHSA-2p8c-ff85-vh9x, https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/releases/tag/pcre2-10.48). The DHI Alpine 3.23 pcre2 packages are built from Alpine's aports APKBUILD for the same version, which applies no patches to the upstream PCRE2 release tarball. The published builds of the pcre2 source in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository are 10.47-r0, 10.48-r0 and 10.49-r0. The version string compiled into libpcre2-8, libpcre2-16 and libpcre2-32 (the pcre2, libpcre2-16 and libpcre2-32 packages) was read from every one of these builds on x86_64 and aarch64 and matches the package version: 10.47-r0 reports PCRE2 10.47, which lacks the fix, and 10.48-r0 and 10.49-r0 report 10.48 and 10.49, which include it.
